verdict.rationale: Lambda has a public pricing page that promises "clear, straightforward pricing" for self-serve instances (B200, H100, A100, GH200), and ODC is priced by hourly usage. A community post also cites a published H100 rate of $1.99/GPU/hour. However, the pack never shows the actual per-GPU-hour figures for each GPU type on that page, and reserved capacity at the lowest prices requires contacting sales. missing for 10: evidence of actual listed per-GPU-hour prices for every GPU type on the public page, sales-free pricing for reserved/cluster tiers, independent corroboration of the current published rates.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see the published per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page without talking to sales

citations.quote: Clear, straightforward pricing for Instances, 1-Click Clusters™, and Superclusters.
Deploy NVIDIA B200, H100, A100, or GH200 instances in minutes with self-serve, first-come access.
ODC prices instances by hourly usage and bills in one-minute increments.
Lambda Labs dropped H100 on-demand GPU pricing to $1.99/GPU/Hour
